title: USDA FSIS: How do I handle leftovers safely?
text: Refrigerate leftovers at 40 °F or below or freeze at 0 °F s soon as possible, but never leave food out more than 2 hours, 1 hour if the outside temperature is above 90 °F . Divide leftovers into shallow containers. This encourages rapid, even cooling. Cover with airtight lids or enclose in plastic wraps or aluminum foil. Use refrigerated leftovers within 3 to 4 days, or freeze them for longer storage.
